settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure Steam connection mode, clock synchronization, offline backups, and appearance.
settings.connectionDesc: The app communicates directly with api.steampowered.com and steamcommunity.com with zero middleman or backend. All 2FA codes are calculated offline.
settings.corsProxyDesc: Steam servers restrict direct in-browser cross-origin (CORS) requests. If you prefer not to use a browser extension, specify your own proxy here. If empty, direct connection and official Steam pages are used.
settings.proxySecretHint: If you set PROXY_SECRET on your Cloudflare Worker, enter it here.
settings.workerTemplateDesc: Quick guide and ready code to deploy your own free Cloudflare Worker:
settings.proxyTest401: Worker rejected request (HTTP 401). X-Proxy-Secret mismatch — check PROXY_SECRET in Cloudflare environment variables.
settings.proxyTestOkSecret: Worker OK! Latency: {{latency}}ms — Secret protection verified
settings.proxyTestOkNoSecret: Worker OK! Latency: {{latency}}ms — Warning: the worker accepted a request without a secret. PROXY_SECRET may not be set.
settings.proxyTestOkOpen: Worker OK! Latency: {{latency}}ms (HTTP {{status}}) — No secret configured (open proxy).
settings.timeSyncDesc: Synchronizes time drift between your local device and Steam servers.
settings.syncFailed: Could not reach Steam time server.
settings.backupDesc: Export or restore all your accounts and settings as a secure JSON backup.
settings.restoreSuccess: Restored {{count}} accounts and proxy settings from backup.
settings.pwaInstallDesc: Install SteamGuard directly onto your phone or PC desktop for instant access without a browser bar.
settings.offlineTotpInfoDesc: Steam Guard 2FA codes are calculated entirely offline using your device's local clock (RFC 6238 TOTP standard). Since modern devices sync time with internet NTP servers automatically, clock drift is typically 0 seconds. Codes remain 100% valid even without active internet access.

installModal.title: Install SteamGuard
installModal.subtitle: Full-screen standalone mobile app experience
installModal.installBtn: Add to Home Screen / Install App
installModal.androidStep1: Tap the three-dots menu in the top right corner.
installModal.androidStep2: Select 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen' from the menu.
installModal.androidStep3: Tap 'Install' in the prompt. The app will be added to your home screen just like from the store!
installModal.iosStep1: Tap the Share icon at the bottom of the Safari screen.
installModal.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
installModal.iosStep3: Tap 'Add' in the top right. The app will launch in full screen without the Safari URL bar!
